correctness.rationale: Using exactly the published clean pi-flux source hopping matrices, the unitary Bloch decomposition gives B(k) with B^3=4J^2 B. The chiral involution forces three propagator singular values to be reciprocal (g,1,g^-1). Direct Frobenius multiplication gives F=3+8us+4u(u-v)s², u=sinh²h, s=sin²(Jt), v=cos²k; differentiation establishes a strict time maximum s=1 for u>0 and momentum minimum v=c_N. Nearest-grid trigonometry yields the modulo-four formula including N=2. All boundaries h=0, time extrema, h→∞ and N asymptotics are addressed. The standalone source-based checker passed 35,620 finite checks; these are corroboration, not a replacement for the proof.

originality.rationale: Six targeted semantic similarity searches in the published mathematical-result index and targeted web/literature comparisons did not reveal the exact three-band propagator-norm formula. The complete relevant model paper was inspected; its flat-band spectrum and nonunitary decoupling do not determine the physical Euclidean norm. Other dynamics papers use different operators/inputs. The exact new all-N global singular-value optimization and modulo-four resonance were derived rather than read from prior results. Priority remains qualified by unindexed or implicit coverage.

value.rationale: A physically natural new observable for a known all-flat-band non-Hermitian cage is the worst-case coherent transient power gain, not merely its spectrum or individual-site intensity. The theorem computes that global gain over every input and time for every periodic cell count, exhibits an exact four-divisibility resonance, proves dimension-uniform boundedness despite nonorthogonal eigenvectors, and quantifies exponential sensitivity to nonreciprocity. These structural design features are not a trivial restatement of flatness, a finite table, or a normalization test.
